subject: repository-read-recovery-classification
source_of_truth: owner operation catalog and separately audited SELECT-only repository handlers
initial_state: read catalog contracts forbid idempotency keys

operations.name: invoke audited read
operations.synchronization: connection lost during first dispatch; retry once on replacement

operations.name: invoke write
operations.synchronization: retain exact keyed-write replay allowlist; other writes never replay

consistency.object: read classification and bounded runtime recovery

assumptions.fairness: replacement connection is available in successful examples

invariants: every nonproject catalog read is classified as a pure read
each eligible read retries at most once
second loss gives read-specific503 without write/idempotency advice
no new mutation replay or key exemption
five project aggregates remain under ProjectWorkApplication failure handling
oracles: dispatcher call histories stale then fresh
real accepted-effect-list read after native faults
